description: Tripo race-unit bodies (tripo-races agent) overlaying Content/Data/Races.json units by priority (RaceMeshes.tripo.json > NPCMeshes.tripo.json > RaceMeshes.free.json > fallback archetype). meshScale brings the raw ~98 cm Tripo body to heightCm BEFORE the archetype's scale; yaw -90; Tripo 'UE5 Mannequin' 61-bone rig; clips are the Tripo preset library (+ text-to-motion where named). Written by Tools/WriteRaceMeshes.py from Saved/TripoRacesIntegration.json; prompts, task ids and credits in Art/TripoRaces.json.

deepspawn_thrall.bakedWeapon: coral club (right arm) and crab claw (left arm)

barbspitter.bakedWeapon: whalebone harpoon slung on the back; spits its spines

thornspitter.bakedWeapon: thorn quivers on the back; spits its thorns

redmoon_axethrower.bakedWeapon: throwing axes on a bandolier (thrown axes are projectiles)

ironhide_drummer.bakedWeapon: war drum on the back and two bone mallets

ironhide_warchief.bakedWeapon: colossal cleaver (right hand) and skull banner on the back

bastion_golem.bakedWeapon: stone slab shield fused to the left forearm

feral_ursoth.bakedWeapon: claws; antler mantle and tree on the back
